verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Supabase's own official MCP server that external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) connect to, and guidance for building MCP servers on Supabase infrastructure — this is the reverse direction (Supabase as server, not as client). There is no evidence that Supabase's AI Assistant or dashboard itself can plug in external MCP servers and consume their tools, so the client-side capability described in this story is unevidenced.
